title: Automatic Payment Points — Northgate Card Late Fee Courtesy Schedule
content:
| Payments credited through automatic payment in the last 12 months | Automatic-payment points |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 10 |
| 1 to 5 | 5 |
| none | none |

For a courtesy reversal of a late fee on a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account, the automatic-payment points follow the payments credited through automatic payment over the last 12 months: 6 or more grant 10 points; 1 to 5 grant 5 points; none grants none.

The count takes the payments whose channel is automatic payment, credited on the account after the same calendar day 12 months before today. Payments made online, in the app, by phone, in store or by mail are not counted.

Hypothetical illustration: a cardholder whose automatic payment drew on each of the last 6 payment due dates has 6 automatic payments and 10 points; one who enrolled 5 months ago and has 5 automatic payments has 5 points.
